name: Framer OG social card — site-gallery mosaic with centre logomark by framer.com
description: A 1200×630 social card built as a full-bleed mosaic: four-to-five uneven columns of saturated site thumbnails (red, orange, lime, pink, violet) separated by thin black gutters, with edge tiles cropped mid-frame. A black vertical column and horizontal band cross at the centre, forming a plus-shaped field of calm where the white logomark sits as the only focal element — there is no headline at all. The density and colour riot of the gallery does the persuading while the solid-black cross and lone white mark anchor the brand.
